# GitHub Copilot Repository Instructions

Follow [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md).

This is a portable, reference-led Agent Skills repository. Keep `SKILL.md` frontmatter valid, preserve `## Output Contract` and `## Stop Conditions`, use progressive disclosure, and do not add native harness configuration or executable skill logic. Review affected behavioral cases with an approved model and run `npx skills add . --list` before proposing completion.
